newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Wharf says to open 300-room hotel in HK.
newsitem.headline: Wharf says to open 300-room hotel in HK.

text.p: Hong Kong-based conglomerate Wharf (Holdings) Ltd said on Friday it will open a "world-class" hotel with more than 300 rooms at its commercial property in the territory's Tsim Sha Tsui tourist district.

The Marco Polo Grand Hotel, a flagship waterfront project of Wharf's hotel management arm Marco Polo Hotels Management Ltd, will occupy some 330,000 square feet with a minimum room size of more than 550 square feet, Wharf said in a statement.
The hotel will sit on the upper floors of the third tower of the Gateway Two development in Harbour City, Wharf's commercial property. The tower is now under construction.
The statement gave no timeframe for the hotel's launch, saying only that Gateway Two is due to be completed in phases between 1997 and 1999.
Marco Polo Hotels will release more details about the project shortly, it said.
The group now operates three hotels in Tsim Tsa Tsui.
